title: Introduce latency-histogram summarizer and compact-release-starter for model profiles
author: Diego Alvarez
release_notes: Add latency histogram summarizer to profile telemetry pipeline. Enable compact auto-release starter that drafts concise changelog snippets using sampled latency distributions and profile deltas. Improves release note signal for performance regressions and makes rollouts faster.
description: Context and motivation: We routinely onboard models with performance profiles but lack a compact, human-readable summary of latency behavior changes between model versions. This PR implements a lightweight latency-histogram summarizer that computes stable buckets, tracks percentile shifts, and emits a compact performance delta that the release pipeline can consume. It also adds a compact-release-starter hook that drafts a short changelog blurb using sampled telemetry and profile metadata to reduce manual drafting time. Design summary: latency_histo module aggregates recent inference traces, normalizes sequence-length buckets, computes p50/p95/p99 deltas and a simple effect-size score; compact-starter formats summary sentences and attaches suggested severity labels (minor/regression/alert). The hook runs as part of on-board and on-profile-update flows and populates a draft release note under releases/autodrafts/<model>-<version>. Commits: 1) Add registry/telemetry/latency_histo.py and unit coverage; 2) Add registry/release/compact_starter.py and template formatter; 3) Integrate hook in registry/onboard/commit_hook.py; 4) Add e2e test harness and synthetic trace generator; 5) Docs: docs/model-profiles/latency-summary.md and examples in docs/release-automation.md. Changed files (high level): registry/telemetry/latency_histo.py; registry/release/compact_starter.py; registry/onboard/commit_hook.py; tests/telemetry/test_latency_histo.py; tests/release/test_compact_starter.py; docs/model-profiles/latency-summary.md; docs/release-automation.md; CI/workflows/registry-release.yml (small addition). Testing and CI: local unit tests included for bucket stability and delta thresholds; e2e test uses synthetic traces to validate sentence generation does not exceed 240 chars. CI initially failed one flaky test (test_compact_starter_template) due to timezone-dependent sample ordering; fixed by normalizing samples in the test and re-run resulting in green on the second run. Performance notes: baseline summarizer runs in ~45ms on average for a 10k-sample window; the hook runs asynchronously to avoid blocking onboarding. Review conversation highlights: Reviewer Maya Chen requested clearer bucket naming and an explicit note about unit of measure (ms) which was addressed in commit 'clarify-buckets-units'; Priya asked for an opt-out flag for auto-drafts which was added as config.registry.release.auto_draft=false by default; Alexei raised concern about cadence spam for frequently re-uploaded profiles and we added a simple dedup window (72h) to avoid duplicate drafts for the same model+variant. Approvals and merge: After two rounds of minor changes the PR received approvals from reviewers and a cross-team thumbs-up from SRE for the asynchronous implementation; merged via squash/merge. Backwards compatibility and rollout: Feature guarded behind config flag; default behavior is off in prod while enabled in staging for 2 weeks. Follow-ups planned: 1) Add changelog quality evaluation that compares drafted blurb against curated release notes (ENG-2219); 2) Hook integration with console UI so SRE/product teams can preview and edit auto-drafts before publishing (ENG-2234). Related work: complements existing profile delta and compact-release tooling but focuses on telemetry-driven, short human-readable performance blurb generation. Notes for reviewers: sample sizes below 1k will cause the summarizer to attach a low-confidence tag and avoid strong claims. Linear links: ENG-2146 (latency summarizer), ENG-2198 (compact release starter).
